**Subtrack:** Data Science  
**Unit scope:** Missingness, inconsistency, deduplication, record linkage, validation rules and data-quality reporting.

- **[DS-T2-005](DS-T2-005-same-patient-two-registers/README.md): Same Patient, Two Registers: Probabilistic vs Deterministic Record Linkage.** Link a primary health centre register to a general hospital register with no shared ID. Build a deterministic baseline and a Fellegi-Sunter linker with blocking, compare them on the precision-recall trade-off using a clerical sample, and recommend an operating point.
- **[DS-T2-006](DS-T2-006-the-feed-that-breaks/README.md): The Feed That Breaks: A Data Contract and Validation Framework for a Partner Feed.** Design a data contract and a contract-driven validation framework for daily agent-banking deliveries from a partner: schema, semantic, freshness, volume and distribution checks, row and delivery quarantine, calendar-aware baselines and alerting, judged on unseen sequences.
